validated_objective: Release the smallest domain-general QIF slice that governs late evidence after closure while preserving historical decisions and accountable human authority
scope: calibration-report schema, example, deterministic verifier, and retained negative fixtures
late signal occurrence/receipt distinction, source and closure traceability, materiality, reopen decision, closure calibration, and governance
docs, AI authoring guide, roadmap, portable package, AOF evidence, tag, and public release
constraints: original closure records are immutable and late signals never reopen incidents automatically
no source authenticity, causality, operational recovery, future safety, autonomous authority, or semantic truth claims
expected_outcomes: late evidence can be attached to a prior closure and evaluated without rewriting history
reopen or keep-closed decisions require accountable human rationale and evidence
later outcomes calibrate prior closure as aligned, false assurance, false alarm, or unknown, with governance for uncertainty
